scope: conditions shared by every run in the park-streaming-benchmark-* artifacts; per-run mode and catalog ride inside each artifact

source.worktree: dirty before measurement (pre-existing input remap and dashboard edits); park_streaming flip for streamed runs reverted after the streamed block

scenario.live_service: not running; park client transport idle

routes.travel: res://tests/park_runtime/fixtures/midway_anchor_route.json; overlook, boardwalk, Firehole bridge, Fairy Falls trailhead, closed loop, 2776.02 m; camera runs add a 1.67 m eye offset
routes.steady: res://tests/park_runtime/fixtures/midway_overlook_steady.json; stationary camera at the overlook anchor at eye height
routes.plateau: res://tests/park_runtime/fixtures/midway_anchor_route_laps.json; three laps of the travel loop
routes.walker: walker_points of the travel fixture (anchor ground positions, straight legs with scripted obstacle sidesteps)

warmup.walker: walker gate wait (streamed collision ready) plus 120 frames
warmup.boot: no warmup; milestones measured from script start

cache_state: engine shader and import caches warm after the first run of each mode; runs serialized one at a time; windows moved to the foreground after launch
abba: baked(a), streamed(a), streamed(b), baked(b) per workload; boot-baked-b is an extra replicate recorded earlier under identical conditions; walker runs are single per mode by duration
